auditorUnsureNote: the unsure seconds are coolant values within 0.5 C of a cut or an age near 30 s, and missing speed for the discharging label; the windows containing them agree with the tool on every count (thermal, labels, unresolved), i.e. none of them changed a class
auditorAmbiguousRules: Window taken by grid index (first resampled second = 0, start and end inclusive, 21 s); consistent with startTime clock times
Grid: floor of first timestamp, reindexed to continuous 1 s grid before ffill(3); gaps become NaN
Spin: rpm NaN after ffill treated as not rotating, so NaN gaps create crossings; crossing at k is the later second of the pair; seconds within |i-k|<=3 flagged
Coolant 'at or before that second': raw sample time <= grid-second start; sub-second samples inside the same second are not used
Coolant boundaries: age exactly 30 s is known (unknown only if > 30); exactly 60 C is cold, exactly 80 C is warming
generation_with_pack_discharge: missing speed treated as not > 5
fuelFlag when fuel mean is NaN after ffill: false; 'zero throughout the file' evaluated on the grid with NaN as 0
dissipation_candidate uses strict rpm > 2000 (Director ruling); rpmExactly2000 = rpm==2000 AND motored AND low load (spin ignored)
Midnight rollover detected by a time decrease > 12 h
Brief says 'comb no_signal when boost missing', ambiguous band -0.70..-0.55 yields 'ambiguous' which gets no label
thermal_context label is independent of comb/flow; a second may carry several labels (non-exclusive); unresolved = no label at all
File name mapping: sample uses '_' between date and time, raw uses a space
